title: NatureMist Classic Trio
descriptionHtml:
Herbal wash and hair-pack collection

Reetha and Shikakai for herbal hair-wash routines, with Amla for a separate traditional hair pack.

What is included

  • 1 × 200 g jar of NatureMist Amla Powder — a traditional fruit-based hair pack.
  • 1 × 200 g jar of NatureMist Reetha Powder — a soapnut ingredient for herbal hair washes.
  • 1 × 200 g jar of NatureMist Shikakai Powder — a pod-based ingredient for traditional hair washing.

Total net quantity: 3 × 200 g (600 g total). The jars are separately packed; this is not a premixed formula.

How to use

  1. Preparation: Read the current directions on each jar and complete the directed skin test before first use.
  2. Routine: Choose the appropriate wash or pack step. Use powders separately unless a tested combination is provided in the product directions.
  3. Application: Mix with clean water, apply only to the intended hair or scalp area, and follow each product's preparation and rinse-out instructions.
  4. After use: Discard leftover wet preparation and close each dry powder jar securely.

Use with care

  • For external hair-care use only. Do not ingest or use as a face/body pack; skin suitability has not been established.
  • Avoid eyes, inhaling loose powder and broken or irritated skin. Stop and rinse if irritation occurs.
  • Strand-test light, grey, bleached, porous or colour-treated hair.
  • Follow each jar's own instructions; combining powders does not establish improved efficacy or tolerance.

About the evidence

This collection is based on traditional cosmetic use and ingredient roles. Product-specific conditioning, hair-growth, skin-care and combination-benefit claims have not been established for this set.

title: NatureMist Bhringraj Hibiscus Duo
descriptionHtml:
Traditional and floral hair-pack duo

Bhringraj and Hibiscus provide a choice of botanical ingredients for traditional hair and scalp-pack routines.

What is included

  • 1 × 200 g jar of NatureMist Bhringraj Powder — a traditional Ayurvedic hair and scalp pack.
  • 1 × 200 g jar of NatureMist Hibiscus Powder — a flower-based ingredient for herbal hair packs.

Total net quantity: 2 × 200 g (400 g total). The jars are separately packed; this is not a premixed formula.

How to use

  1. Preparation: Read the current directions on each jar and complete the directed skin test before first use.
  2. Routine: Choose the appropriate wash or pack step. Use powders separately unless a tested combination is provided in the product directions.
  3. Application: Mix with clean water, apply only to the intended hair or scalp area, and follow each product's preparation and rinse-out instructions.
  4. After use: Discard leftover wet preparation and close each dry powder jar securely.

Use with care

  • For external hair-care use only. Do not ingest or use as a face/body pack; skin suitability has not been established.
  • Avoid eyes, inhaling loose powder and broken or irritated skin. Stop and rinse if irritation occurs.
  • Strand-test light, grey, bleached, porous or colour-treated hair.
  • Follow each jar's own instructions; combining powders does not establish improved efficacy or tolerance.

About the evidence

This collection is based on traditional cosmetic use and ingredient roles. Product-specific conditioning, hair-growth, skin-care and combination-benefit claims have not been established for this set.
